title: Observing Micromotives and Macrobehavior of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the Schelling segregation model by prompting LLMs as demographic agents (young vs. old) to rate their preference to 'move' or 'stay' based on the demographic makeup of their neighbors, and calculating the resulting macro-level segregation shift.
